The HD cutscenes and HD menus come from your own copies of the HD collections. They are made on a Windows PC, then copied here:
1. On a Windows PC where KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is installed (Steam or Epic), download the KH 358/2 Days Port installer: github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port/releases
2. Run it. When it asks for your ROM, give it the same .nds file. Tick HD videos. Tick HD menus as well if you also have KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

3. When it is done, copy the folder it installed to onto this device, with a USB cable or an SD card. The whole folder is fine (only its data\\cutscenes and mods folders are used). Any folder on this device will do, such as Download.
4. Choose that folder here. The HD files are copied in and turned on.
HD menus and HUD: not added
